biped.label: Biped
biped.line: The all-round frame: the pendulum stride and a jump.

reverse.label: Reverse joint
reverse.line: A spring in the joint: jumps twice as high, carries less.

tetra.label: Tetrapod
tetra.line: Hovers still for free: a steady platform, slow to walk.

tank.label: Tank
tank.line: Treads: carries the most, turns on the spot, never jumps.

clayHead.label: Clay head
clayHead.line: A haniwa face. It sees far enough.

watcherHead.label: Watcher head
watcherHead.line: Long sight: locks at half again the range.

clayCore.label: Clay core
clayCore.line: The cradle in its chest, the generator at its back.

kilnCore.label: Kiln core
kilnCore.line: Fired twice: the core cracks a third less.

lightCore.label: Light core
lightCore.line: Bisque thin: light, and it cracks sooner.

clayArms.label: Clay arms
clayArms.line: Holds what a frame needs, punches well.

strongArms.label: Strong arms
strongArms.line: Holds heavy weapons; a harder fist.

quickArms.label: Quick arms
quickArms.line: Light and quick to aim; holds little.

clayLegs.label: Clay legs
clayLegs.line: Biped. The stride every frame learns on.

springLegs.label: Spring legs
springLegs.line: Reverse joint: twice the jump, less load.

crabLegs.label: Crab legs
crabLegs.line: Tetrapod: a steady platform that hovers still.

treadLegs.label: Tread base
treadLegs.line: Tank: the heaviest load, treads, no jump.

clayBooster.label: Clay booster
clayBooster.line: Enough thrust to dash and hop.

highBooster.label: High booster
highBooster.line: Half again the thrust, and the draw.

clayGenerator.label: Clay generator
clayGenerator.line: Five minutes off the cable at rest.

fist.label: Fist
fist.line: Three punches, the third a heavy one.

bigGun.label: Blaster
bigGun.line: Shots on a press; held, a beam that pierces a barrier.

greatBlade.label: Blade
greatBlade.line: A cutlass string of three; the third staggers.

shield.label: Shield
shield.line: Raised, it takes blows from the front.

flamer.label: Flamer
flamer.line: Hold G: fire in a cone ahead. It lights timber, paper and straw.
